threads.name: The treasure map
threads.note: Dr. Uriah carries the map and plans to copy it, the party means to check a marked location on the way north, and Father William added marks to it. The treasure is still unfound.

threads.name: The Clurichen of the riverbanks
threads.note: The question of what the Clurichen does is answered: Naggeneen drinks Quinn's booze (beat_18). He is now captive in a bag behind Quinn's bar (beat_19, beat_37), and his offer of a pot of gold or a secret still stands, so the situation remains open in a new shape.

threads.name: The dragon and the Reeve's bounty
threads.note: George revealed where the lair is (beat_58), and the danger has escalated because the dragon will soon fly. The party learned the dragon can only be killed with Brandon's sword (beat_51), and George doubts the Reeve has the bounty (beat_60). The dragon is still alive.

threads.name: Hiring Lady Hilda
threads.note: Hilda was only seen in passing. Sir Phidipaldi's promise to return for her services is unreleased.

threads.name: Drop Dead Ned's offer
threads.note: Ned was only seen in passing, and his offer remains undecided.

threads.name: Brandonsford's missing shipments
threads.note: Shipments still had not come in, and the cause is still unknown.

threads.name: Sir Phidipaldi's quarrel with Eric the Reeve
threads.note: Phidipaldi still scorns Eric as a man of no honor. Nothing shows the duel happened or was declined.

threads.name: Shamus the mule
threads.note: Gill is willing to go lower than his price and would drop it once his boys return, but no deal for the mule is made yet.

threads.name: Warwick's mithril chain shirt
threads.note: Dunk confirmed the shirt is magical, scouted Warwick's house and has a plan to get it, but he does not have it yet.

threads.name: Quinn's revenge on Bentley
threads.note: The thief turned out to be Naggeneen, not Bentley (beat_18), and Quinn paid the party for catching him (beat_19). Nothing remains owed or unknown.

threads.name: Squints and Trout's Halfling Corps
threads.note: Trout recruited Squints on stated terms, including picks after the first treasure, and that arrangement is ongoing. Trout's secret intent not to rescue him also belongs to this relationship.

threads.name: Ingrid's sleeping potion for Warwick
threads.note: Dunk's bargain with Ingrid is one deal: he supplies the faun wine and helps her dose Warwick, she makes the potion, and he holds her secret. Dunk stated it serves his plan to get Warwick's armor (beat_33, beat_44). The potion is not yet made, and they are to meet tonight.

threads.name: Sir Brandon's magic sword at the Barrow Mound
threads.note: Father William says the dragon can't be killed without the sword buried with Brandon (beat_51), so this serves the dragon hunt. The party is heading to the Barrow, and Brother Dirk's willingness to continue is unsettled (beat_86).

threads.name: Dr. Uriah's penance and donation at the Barrow Mound
threads.note: Uriah promised Father William penance at the Barrow Mound and a 10 gold donation for its upkeep. That promise is still owed.

threads.name: Why the hidden fairies are coming out
threads.note: Ingrid reports that fairies which used to stay hidden are encroaching more often. This is an unexplained change that stands apart from the dragon.

threads.name: The giant in the cyclopean cottage
threads.note: A man-eating giant on the road north woke as the party rescued Dirk, then chased them until he tired. Escaping him does not end the danger.

standalone_beats.reason: Ingrid's wares, including healing tea and magic-revealing witch powder, are a useful resource tied to no thread.
Father William offers to heal Uriah if he is injured, a resource tied to no thread.
Uriah bought essence of wolfsbane and mandrake root tea, which adds to the party's supplies.
